ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly dominant low-intensity black pixels with a macro-level ratio of approximately 95:5 against high-intensity white markers and tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous solid black pigmentation across both lobes; distinct high-contrast white geometric clusters at both distal tips; isolated circular white focal spot located on the mid-left lobe region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated 45 to 55-degree interior angle and deep recession into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile with multiple sharp pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave upward curve originating from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the distal tips of both lobes; isolated circular white rosette on the central-left fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple short, unaligned thin white linear disruptions (rake marks) scattered across both the left and right fluke surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on both distal tips; one prominent circular white scar on the left lobe surface; various linear rake marks on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, high-contrast circular 'eye' shaped white mark on the central-left lobe.
